_note: USD per search for the DIRECT arms, used only to ESTIMATE direct-vendor search cost in scripts/jevlin_bench/measures.py. Each figure is the published PAYG list price for one request of up to 10 results. Jevlin arms are never priced from this file: the gateway meters every search and the runner records usage.cost_micros on the cost event (usd_observed). The two are reported side by side and never summed.
